business.name: Tallowwood
business.headline: Made for every day, and for a long time.
business.intro: Linen woven for us in Lithuania, stoneware thrown in Marrickville, and boards cut from salvaged spotted gum. Free delivery over $250.

story.title: Made slowly, by people we know
story.body: We started Tallowwood in 2011 with one linen supplier and a market stall. We still visit every workshop we buy from, and we still name every maker on the label.
